  Scenario: AC8 Each business rule BR1 to BR13 of section 8 is declared in the baseline and checked by a criterion (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the business rules of section 8
    When each of BR1 to BR13 is compared with the criteria of this section
    Then BR1, BR8 and BR11 are checked by AC2 and AC7 for the element declarations, the status vocabulary and the single base, topic, queue and login
    Then BR2 and BR13 are checked by AC4 for the entry and the clock, with no service level, no escalation point and no status value as a default or a constant
    Then BR3, BR4 and BR6 are checked by AC3, AC4, AC6 and AC7 for the case and its route state, the rule package and the ledger, and the absent Schedule
    Then BR5 is checked by AC7 for the absent events, and BR7 is checked by AC5 for the rights and the scope of the partner portal user
    Then BR9 is checked by a result submitted on an instruction that reads RECALLED being refused, with the refusal code Not specified in the source documents (GAP-3130; ASM-5470)
    Then BR10 is checked by the absence of any personal data in a schema, an example or a fake beyond a partner code, a partner type, case and instruction references, a status, a date and a rule version
    Then BR12 is checked by the document recording that a schema change is additive within major version 1 and that a breaking change is a new major version
